title: 5 AppSumo Software Deals to Watch Without Monthly Bills
subtitle: Explore these software options available on AppSumo to help run your small business efficiently.
html:
Disclosure: this post contains affiliate links. If you buy through them, I may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.

Running a small business or freelancing solo often means juggling a growing stack of monthly software subscriptions. Over time, those recurring fees add up and eat into your profits.

Looking at lifetime software deals on platforms like AppSumo is one way to cut down on fixed costs. Here is a look at five options currently available for various business needs.

SuperOkay: Quickly share project information

SuperOkay provides a customizable client portal where you can share project information, assets, and tasks all in one place. It helps keep communication organized and cuts down on endless email threads with clients.

When considering this tool, remember that lifetime deals depend on the company staying in business. Always check the plan limits and refund window on the deal page before purchasing.

See the SuperOkay deal on AppSumo

Squirrly SEO: Rank up your WordPress site

Squirrly SEO helps you optimize your WordPress site using data-driven SEO goals guided by an AI consultant. It breaks down complex optimization tasks into actionable steps for site owners.

Before adding it to your workflow, keep in mind that software features and AI limits can vary by tier. Check the plan limits and refund window on the deal page to ensure it fits your traffic needs.

See the Squirrly SEO deal on AppSumo

Typedesk: Ditch repetitive typing

Typedesk is a canned response solution designed to help you stop typing the same messages over and over again. It works across different applications to speed up your customer support and client emails.

As with any software purchase, remember that ongoing support depends on the provider staying active. Check the plan limits and refund window on the deal page before making a commitment.

See the Typedesk deal on AppSumo

Viloud: Create an online TV channel

Viloud lets you create an online TV channel or livestream for your brand so you can publish and monetize video content. It offers a straightforward way to distribute pre-recorded or live video feeds.

Streaming tools require careful review of bandwidth and storage caps. Check the plan limits and refund window on the deal page to confirm it matches your video output volume.

See the Viloud deal on AppSumo

WebWave: Build professional custom websites

WebWave allows you to build professional, custom websites tailored to any client without having to write code. It gives designers and agencies flexibility in layout creation and client handoff.

Platform longevity is important when moving client sites over. Check the plan limits and refund window on the deal page to verify white-label options and hosting terms.

See the WebWave deal on AppSumo

How to choose

Choosing the right tool comes down to identifying your current bottlenecks. Pick the software that directly solves a daily friction point in your business rather than buying just for the discount.

Always take a few minutes to carefully read the deal terms, user limits, and refund policies on AppSumo before finalizing your purchase.
